snippet.title: The Elf on the Shelf: Christmas Heroes | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🎄✨ Do you believe in Christmas Magic? BecomeGame like a Scout Elf and help Santa save Christmas in The Elf on the Shelf: Christmas Heroes! Out now. 

✨ Complete your Scout Elf training at the North Pole and earn your place on Santa’s team. 
✨ Explore magical levels across the home, backyard, and beyond while dodging nutcrackers and ornaments. 
✨ Play festive minigames — solve puzzles, match cards, sort ornaments, and find your way through mazes. 
✨ Collect Christmas Spirit as you run, jump, and swing through every level. 
✨ Design your very own Scout Elf with sparkling seasonal accessories. 

Spread holiday cheer and save Christmas with Santa. Are you ready to be a Christmas Hero? 

#TheElfonTheShelf  #TheElfonTheShelfChristmasHeroes #ElfontheShelf
